description: Suggests the best short clips in one saved transcript, as start and end times with a hook line. Best for: "find the best 60 seconds", "which parts would make good shorts". Returns: each clip's start and end in seconds and as clock times, a hook line, the text, a 0 to 100 rank score and the reasons. Input tips: pass the transcript_id from transcribe_media, and library_id when that answer had one. Optional: count (1 to 5, default 3), min_seconds (default 30) and max_seconds (default 60); keep min_seconds below max_seconds. Not for: cutting, editing or posting video; it returns text only. Scores rank clips against each other and do not predict views.

count.description: How many clips to suggest, such as 2 (default 3).

library_id.description: The library_id an earlier transcribe_media answer returned, such as lib_9b6a98861ea4f54bff8f5cf1. It names the set of transcripts that call saved. Pass it when that answer had one; leave it out when it was null or absent.

max_seconds.description: Longest clip in seconds, such as 20 (default 60). It must be above min_seconds; a smaller value is raised to min_seconds + 5.

min_seconds.description: Shortest clip in seconds, such as 10 (default 30). Keep it below max_seconds.

transcript_id.description: The transcript_id from transcribe_media or search_transcripts, such as tr_a6f8c87a9b2eb748.

name: suggest_clips

as_of.description: The UTC day of the answer, such as 2026-10-10.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the clip, in seconds.

end.description: End, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

from.description: Start as a clock time, such as 0:34.

hook.description: The opening sentence, to use as the clip's hook line.

score.description: Rank from 0 to 100 against the other clips of this transcript; it does not predict views.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

to.description: End as a clock time, such as 1:02.

status.description: ok: clips found. none: the transcript has no stretch of the asked length; try other min_seconds and max_seconds. A refused call returns no object, only an error text such as "transcript_not_found: ..." that says what to do next.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

title: Suggest short clips from a transcript
